非线性模型的监督学习
Chapter 7: Deep learning · 7.1 Supervised learning with non-linear models

Page 82

We now begin our study of deep learning. In this set of notes, we give an overview of neural networks, discuss vectorization and discuss training neural networks with backpropagation.

In the supervised learning setting (predicting y from the input x), suppose our model/hypothesis is hθ​(x). In the past lectures, we have considered the cases when hθ​(x)=θ⊤x (in linear regression or logistic regression) or hθ​(x)=θ⊤ϕ(x) (where φ(x) is the feature map). A commonality of these two models is that they are linear in the parameters θ. Next we will consider learning general family of models that are non-linear in both the parameters θ and the inputs x. The most common non-linear models are neural networks, which we will define staring from the next section. For this section, it suffices to think hθ​(x) as an abstract non-linear model.

(Footnote 1) If a concrete example is helpful, perhaps think about the model hθ​(x)=θ12​x12​+θ22​x22​+⋯+θd2​xd2​ in this subsection, even though it's not a neural network.

第二部分「深度学习」开始. 本章概述神经网络, 讲向量化, 以及用反向传播训练神经网络. 以前的模型 θ⊤x、θ⊤ϕ(x) 有一个共同点: 对参数 θ 是线性的 (后者对 x 可以是非线性的, 但 φ 是固定的). 现在要学的模型对参数和输入都是非线性的, 最常见的就是神经网络. 本节先把 hθ​(x) 当作抽象的非线性模型; 脚注给了一个具体例子 ∑k​θk2​xk2​, 它对 θ 是二次的, 所以不再是线性模型.

对参数非线性带来的最大变化: 损失函数一般不再是凸的, 没有正规方程那样的闭式解, 梯度下降也只能保证找到局部最优或驻点. 但实践中梯度类方法在神经网络上效果很好.

讲义笔误: "which we will define staring from the next section" 中 staring 应为 starting; "learning general family of models" 漏了冠词 a.

Page 82–83

Suppose {(x(i),y(i))}i=1n​ are the training examples. For simplicity, we start with the case where y(i)∈R and hθ​(x)∈R.

Cost/loss function. We define the least square cost function for the i-th example (x(i),y(i)) as

J(i)(θ)=21​(hθ​(x(i))−y(i))2(7.1)

and define the mean-square cost function for the dataset as

J(θ)=n1​i=1∑n​J(i)(θ)(7.2)

which is same as in linear regression except that we introduce a constant 1/n in front of the cost function to be consistent with the convention. Note that multiplying the cost function with a scalar will not change the local minima or global minima of the cost function. Also note that the underlying parameterization for hθ​(x) is different from the case of linear regression, even though the form of the cost function is the same mean-squared loss. Throughout the notes, we use the words “loss” and “cost” interchangeably.

先考虑输出是实数的回归. 每个样本的损失是平方误差 (7.1), 整个数据集取平均 (7.2). 与线性回归相比只多了 1/n, 乘常数不改变极小点的位置. 损失的形式相同, 但 hθ​ 的参数化不同, 所以 J(θ) 作为 θ 的函数形状完全不同. 本章中 loss 和 cost 同义.

为什么神经网络的损失不是凸的: 一个简单的论证是对称性. 把两层网络中两个隐藏单元连同它们的进出权重互换位置, 函数完全不变, 所以若 θ 是极小点, 互换后的 θ′ 也是; 但两者的平均 (θ + θ′)/2 让这两个单元的权重变得相同, 一般不再是极小点. 凸函数的极小点集合必须是凸集, 所以损失不可能是凸的. m 个隐藏单元有 m! 种排列, 对应 m! 个等价的极小点.

Page 83

Optimizers (SGD). Commonly, people use gradient descent (GD), stochastic gradient (SGD), or their variants to optimize the loss function J(θ). GD's update rule can be written as

θ:=θ−α∇θ​J(θ)(7.3)

where α > 0 is often referred to as the learning rate or step size. Next, we introduce a version of the SGD (Algorithm 1), which is lightly different from that in the first lecture notes.

Algorithm 1 Stochastic Gradient Descent

  1. Hyperparameter: learning rate α, number of total iteration niter​.
  2. Initialize θ randomly.
  3. for i = 1 to niter​ do
  4. Sample j uniformly from {1, …, n}, and update θ by θ:=θ−α∇θ​J(j)(θ) (7.4)

(Footnote 2) Recall that, as defined in the previous lecture notes, we use the notation “a := b” to denote an operation (in a computer program) in which we set the value of a variable a to be equal to the value of b. … In contrast, we will write “a = b” when we are asserting a statement of fact, that the value of a is equal to the value of b.

优化器: 梯度下降 (7.3) 或随机梯度下降 (SGD). 这里的 SGD 与第 1 章略有不同: 每一步均匀随机抽一个样本 j 来更新, 而不是按顺序遍历数据集; 参数要随机初始化 (神经网络若全部初始化为 0, 同一层的神经元会一直保持相同, 无法学到不同的特征). 脚注重申记号:「a := b」是程序里的赋值, 「a = b」是陈述两者相等.

讲义笔误: "which is lightly different" 应为 slightly; "stochastic gradient (SGD)" 漏了 descent.

Page 83–84

Oftentimes computing the gradient of B examples simultaneously for the parameter θ can be faster than computing B gradients separately due to hardware parallelization. Therefore, a mini-batch version of SGD is most commonly used in deep learning, as shown in Algorithm 2. There are also other variants of the SGD or mini-batch SGD with slightly different sampling schemes.

Algorithm 2 Mini-batch Stochastic Gradient Descent

  1. Hyperparameters: learning rate α, batch size B, # iterations niter​.
  2. Initialize θ randomly
  3. for i = 1 to niter​ do
  4. Sample B examples j1​,…,jB​ (without replacement) uniformly from {1, …, n}, and update θ by θ:=θ−Bα​k=1∑B​∇θ​J(jk​)(θ)(7.5)​

With these generic algorithms, a typical deep learning model is learned with the following steps. 1. Define a neural network parametrization hθ​(x), which we will introduce in Section 7.2, and 2. write the backpropagation algorithm to compute the gradient of the loss function J(j)(θ) efficiently, which will be covered in Section 7.3, and 3. run SGD or mini-batch SGD (or other gradient-based optimizers) with the loss function J(θ).

小批量 SGD: 硬件 (GPU) 并行时, 同时算 B 个样本的梯度比分开算 B 次快得多, 所以深度学习最常用的是每步抽 B 个样本 (不放回), 用它们梯度的平均来更新 (7.5). B = 1 就是普通 SGD, B = n 就是批量梯度下降. 训练深度模型的三步: ① 定义网络结构 hθ​ (7.2 节); ② 用反向传播高效计算梯度 (7.3 节); ③ 运行 (小批量) SGD 或其他梯度优化器.

术语: 遍历一遍全部训练数据叫一个 epoch, n 个样本、批大小 B 时一个 epoch 约 n/B 步. 深度学习论文常用「训练了多少个 epoch」描述训练量. 讲义中的 niter​ 是总步数, 不是 epoch 数.

B 的取舍: 小批量梯度是全梯度的无偏估计, 方差约为单样本梯度方差的 1/B. B 越大, 每步的方向越准, 但每步计算更多; 常见做法是把 B 取到 GPU 能高效并行的规模 (如 32 到几千), 学习率随 B 适当调大. 实践中多数实现并不是每步独立随机抽样, 而是每个 epoch 把数据随机打乱后按顺序切成小批量, 这就是讲义说的「略有不同的抽样方案».

神经网络
7.2 Neural networks

Page 84–85

Neural networks refer to broad type of non-linear models/parametrizations hθ​(x) that involve combinations of matrix multiplications and other entry-wise non-linear operations. We will start small and slowly build up a neural network, step by step.

A Neural Network with a Single Neuron. Recall the housing price prediction problem from before: given the size of the house, we want to predict the price. … Previously, we fit a straight line to the graph of size vs. housing price. Now, instead of fitting a straight line, we wish to prevent negative housing prices by setting the absolute minimum price as zero. This produces a “kink” in the graph as shown in Figure 7.1. How do we represent such a function with a single kink as hθ​(x) with unknown parameter?

We define a parameterized function hθ​(x) with input x, parameterized by θ, which outputs the price of the house y. Formally, hθ​:x→y. Perhaps one of the simplest parametrization would be

​hθ​(x)=max(wx+b,0),where θ=(w,b)∈R2(7.6)​

神经网络泛指由矩阵乘法和逐元素非线性运算组合而成的一大类模型. 从最简单的开始: 只用面积预测房价, 为了避免预测出负的房价, 把最低价设为 0, 拟合的函数在某处出现一个折点 (kink): 左边是水平的 0, 右边是斜线. 最简单的参数化就是 max(wx+b,0), 参数只有 w、b.

Page 85

Here hθ​(x) returns a single value: (wx + b) or zero, whichever is greater. In the context of neural networks, the function max{t, 0} is called a ReLU (pronounced “ray-lu”), or rectified linear unit, and often denoted by ReLU(t)≜max{t,0}.

Generally, a one-dimensional non-linear function that maps ℝ to ℝ such as ReLU is often referred to as an activation function. The model hθ​(x) is said to have a single neuron partly because it has a single non-linear activation function. (We will discuss more about why a non-linear activation is called neuron.)

When the input x∈Rd has multiple dimensions, a neural network with a single neuron can be written as

​hθ​(x)=ReLU(w⊤x+b),where w∈Rd,b∈R,and θ=(w,b)(7.7)​

The term b is often referred to as the “bias”, and the vector w is referred to as the weight vector. Such a neural network has 1 layer. (We will define what multiple layers mean in the sequel.)

max{t, 0} 叫 ReLU (整流线性单元): 正数原样输出, 负数变成 0. 像 ReLU 这样从实数到实数的非线性函数叫激活函数. 只有一个激活函数的模型叫单个神经元. 多维输入时, 单个神经元就是 ReLU(w⊤x+b): 先做线性组合, 再过激活函数. b 叫偏置, w 叫权重向量, 这是一层网络. 注意: 若把 ReLU 换成 sigmoid, 单个神经元就是逻辑回归的假设函数.

ReLU 在 0 处的导数: max{t, 0} 在 t = 0 处不可导 (左导数 0, 右导数 1). 实现中约定取 0 (PyTorch 即如此) 或 1, 因为浮点数恰好等于 0 的概率极小, 取哪个对训练几乎没有影响. 严格地说, 这时算的是一个「次梯度», 反向传播的定理 7.3.1 默认各运算可微, 对 ReLU 这样只有个别不可导点的函数在实践中照样使用.

Page 85–86

Stacking Neurons. A more complex neural network may take the single neuron described above and “stack” them together such that one neuron passes its output as input into the next neuron, resulting in a more complex function.

Let us now deepen the housing prediction example. In addition to the size of the house, suppose that you know the number of bedrooms, the zip code and the wealth of the neighborhood. Building neural networks is analogous to Lego bricks: you take individual bricks and stack them together to build complex structures. …

Given these features (size, number of bedrooms, zip code, and wealth), we might then decide that the price of the house depends on the maximum family size it can accommodate. Suppose the family size is a function of the size of the house and number of bedrooms (see Figure 7.2). The zip code may provide additional information such as how walkable the neighborhood is (i.e., can you walk to the grocery store or do you need to drive everywhere). Combining the zip code with the wealth of the neighborhood may predict the quality of the local elementary school. Given these three derived features (family size, walkable, school quality), we may conclude that the price of the home ultimately depends on these three features.

堆叠神经元: 一个神经元的输出作为下一个神经元的输入, 像搭乐高积木. 房价例子扩展为四个输入: 面积、卧室数、邮编、社区富裕程度. 人为设想三个中间量: 面积和卧室数决定能住多大的家庭; 邮编决定步行是否方便; 邮编加富裕程度决定小学的质量. 房价最终取决于这三个中间量. 图中每个圆圈是一个神经元, 箭头表示依赖关系.

Page 86–87

Formally, the input to a neural network is a set of input features x1​,x2​,x3​,x4​. We denote the intermediate variables for “family size”, “walkable”, and “school quality” by a1​,a2​,a3​ (these ai​'s are often referred to as “hidden units” or “hidden neurons”). We represent each of the ai​'s as a neural network with a single neuron with a subset of x1​,…,x4​ as inputs. Then as in Figure 7.1, we will have the parameterization:

a1​a2​a3​​=ReLU(θ1​x1​+θ2​x2​+θ3​)=ReLU(θ4​x3​+θ5​)=ReLU(θ6​x3​+θ7​x4​+θ8​)​

where (θ1​,⋯,θ8​) are parameters. Now we represent the final output hθ​(x) as another linear function with a1​,a2​,a3​ as inputs, and we get

hθ​(x)=θ9​a1​+θ10​a2​+θ11​a3​+θ12​(7.8)

where θ contains all the parameters (θ1​,⋯,θ12​).

Now we represent the output as a quite complex function of x with parameters θ. Then you can use this parametrization hθ​ with the machinery of Section 7.1 to learn the parameters θ.

(Footnote 3) Typically, for multi-layer neural network, at the end, near the output, we don't apply ReLU, especially when the output is not necessarily a positive number.

形式化: 输入 x1​,…,x4​; 三个中间量记作 a1​,a2​,a3​, 叫隐藏单元 (隐藏神经元), 每个都是以部分输入为输入的单个神经元. 输出层是 a1​,a2​,a3​ 的线性函数 (7.8). 全部 12 个参数一起用 7.1 节的方法学习. 脚注: 多层网络的最后一层通常不加 ReLU, 因为输出不一定是正数.

讲义问题: "Then as in Figure 7.1, we will have the parameterization" 引用不对: Figure 7.1 是折点房价图, 这里的参数化方式对应的是单神经元公式 (7.6)/(7.7) (或 Figure 7.2 的结构).

Page 87

Inspiration from Biological Neural Networks. As the name suggests, artificial neural networks were inspired by biological neural networks. The hidden units a1​,…,am​ correspond to the neurons in a biological neural network, and the parameters θi​'s correspond to the synapses. However, it's unclear how similar the modern deep artificial neural networks are to the biological ones. For example, perhaps not many neuroscientists think biological neural networks could have 1000 layers, while some modern artificial neural networks do (we will elaborate more on the notion of layers.) Moreover, it's an open question whether human brains update their neural networks in a way similar to the way that computer scientists learn artificial neural networks (using backpropagation, which we will introduce in the next section.).

生物学启发: 人工神经网络受生物神经网络启发, 隐藏单元对应神经元, 参数对应突触. 但现代深度网络与大脑有多相似并不清楚: 很少有神经科学家认为大脑有 1000 层, 而有些人工网络有; 大脑是否用类似反向传播的方式学习也是未解的问题. 所以「神经网络」这个名字更多是历史原因, 理解它时把它当作一种参数化函数族即可.

历史小注: 最早的人工神经元模型是 McCulloch 和 Pitts (1943) 的阈值单元, Rosenblatt (1958) 的感知机可以学习权重. 多层网络的反向传播在 1986 年由 Rumelhart、Hinton、Williams 推广开来. 2012 年 AlexNet 在 ImageNet 上大幅领先, 依靠的正是 GPU 并行、ReLU 和大数据, 与本章强调的向量化、反向传播一脉相承.

Page 87

Two-layer Fully-Connected Neural Networks. We constructed the neural network in equation (7.8) using a significant amount of prior knowledge/belief about how the “family size”, “walkable”, and “school quality” are determined by the inputs. We implicitly assumed that we know the family size is an important quantity to look at and that it can be determined by only the “size” and “# bedrooms”. Such a prior knowledge might not be available for other applications. It would be more flexible and general to have a generic parameterization. A simple way would be to write the intermediate variable a1​ as a function of all x1​,…,x4​:

a1​a2​a3​​=ReLU(w1⊤​x+b1​),(7.9)=ReLU(w2⊤​x+b2​),=ReLU(w3⊤​x+b3​),where w1​,w2​,w3​∈R4and b1​,b2​,b3​∈R​

We still define hθ​(x) using equation (7.8) with a1​,a2​,a3​ being defined as above. Thus we have a so-called fully-connected neural network as visualized in the dependency graph in Figure 7.3 because all the intermediate variables ai​'s depend on all the inputs xi​'s.

(7.8) 的网络用了大量先验知识: 我们事先知道家庭规模是重要的量, 而且只由面积和卧室数决定. 其他应用往往没有这种知识. 更通用的做法: 让每个隐藏单元依赖所有输入, 由数据决定每条连接的权重 (不重要的连接权重会学成接近 0). 这就是全连接神经网络. 代价是参数更多 (每个隐藏单元 4 + 1 个参数, 而不是 2 到 3 个).

参数个数对比: 图 7.2 的手工网络有 12 个参数 (3 + 2 + 3 个隐藏层参数, 加上输出层的 4 个). 全连接版本中每个隐藏单元有 4 个权重和 1 个偏置, 共 3 × 5 = 15, 加输出层 4 个, 合计 19 个. 多出的 7 个参数让网络能自己发现哪些输入组合有用, 代价是需要更多数据来确定它们.

Page 88

Figure 7.3: Diagram of a two-layer fully connected neural network. Each edge from node xi​ to node aj​ indicates that aj​ depends on xi​. The edge from xi​ to aj​ is associated with the weight (wj[1]​)i​ which denotes the i-th coordinate of the vector wj[1]​. The activation aj​ can be computed by taking the ReLUof the weighted sum of xi​'s with the weights being the weights associated with the incoming edges, that is, aj​=ReLU(∑i=1d​(wj[1]​)i​xi​).

读图: 每条边 xi​→aj​ 带一个权重 (wj[1]​)i​ (第 j 个隐藏单元的权重向量的第 i 个分量); 每个隐藏单元把所有进入它的边的「权重 × 输入」相加, 再取 ReLU. 上层同理, 输出只有一个单元, 不加 ReLU.

讲义问题: ① 图注 "taking the ReLUof" 少一个空格; 图注公式 aj​=ReLU(∑i​(wj[1]​)i​xi​) 漏了偏置 bj[1]​. ② 图中是 3 个输入、4 个隐藏单元, 而正文的例子是 4 个输入、3 个隐藏单元, 两者不一致 (图只是示意).

Page 88

For full generality, a two-layer fully-connected neural network with m hidden units and d dimensional input x∈Rd is defined as

​∀j∈[1,…,m]:zj​=wj[1]⊤​x+bj[1]​,where wj[1]​∈Rd,bj[1]​∈R(7.10)aj​=ReLU(zj​),a=[a1​,…,am​]⊤∈Rmhθ​(x)=w[2]⊤a+b[2],where w[2]∈Rm,b[2]∈R(7.11)​

Note that by default the vectors in Rd are viewed as column vectors, and in particular a is a column vector with components a1​,a2​,…,am​. The indices [1] and [2] are used to distinguish two sets of parameters: the wj[1]​'s (each of which is a vector in Rd) and w[2] (which is a vector in Rm). We will have more of these later.

一般的两层全连接网络: d 维输入, m 个隐藏单元. 每个隐藏单元先算线性组合 zj​ (称为预激活), 再取 ReLU 得 aj​; 输出是 a 的线性函数. 上标 [1]、[2] 表示第几层的参数 (方括号表示层号, 后面圆括号表示样本号, 不要混淆). 向量默认是列向量.

Page 88–89

Vectorization. Before we introduce neural networks with more layers and more complex structures, we will simplify the expressions for neural networks with more matrix and vector notations. Another important motivation of vectorization is the speed perspective in the implementation. In order to implement a neural network efficiently, one must be careful when using for loops. The most natural way to implement equation (7.10) in code is perhaps to use a for loop. In practice, the dimensionalities of the inputs and hidden units are high. As a result, code will run very slowly if you use for loops. Leveraging the parallelism in GPUs is/was crucial for the progress of deep learning.

This gave rise to vectorization. Instead of using for loops, vectorization takes advantage of matrix algebra and highly optimized numerical linear algebra packages (e.g., BLAS) to make neural network computations run quickly. Before the deep learning era, a for loop may have been sufficient on smaller datasets, but modern deep networks and state-of-the-art datasets will be infeasible to run with for loops.

向量化有两个动机: 记号更简洁; 实现更快. 用 for 循环逐个算 zj​ 在维数很高时极慢; 改写成矩阵运算后可以调用高度优化的线性代数库 (如 BLAS), 并利用 GPU 的并行能力, 这对深度学习的发展至关重要. 在 Python 里, 解释器每执行一次循环体都有固定开销, 而一次矩阵乘法在底层 C/Fortran 代码中完成, 差距可达几十到几百倍.

Page 89

We vectorize the two-layer fully-connected neural network as below. We define a weight matrix W[1] in Rm×d as the concatenation of all the vectors wj​'s in the following way:

W[1]=​—w1[1]⊤​——w2[1]⊤​—⋮—wm[1]⊤​—​​∈Rm×d(7.12)

Now by the definition of matrix vector multiplication, we can write z=[z1​,…,zm​]⊤∈Rm as

​z1​⋮zm​​​=​—w1[1]⊤​—⋮—wm[1]⊤​—​​​x1​⋮xd​​​+​b1[1]​⋮bm[1]​​​

​z∈Rm×1,W[1]∈Rm×d,x∈Rd×1,b∈Rm×1​

(7.13) Or succinctly,

z=W[1]x+b[1](7.14)

We remark again that a vector in Rd in this notes, following the conventions previously established, is automatically viewed as a column vector, and can also be viewed as a d × 1 dimensional matrix. (Note that this is different from numpy where a vector is viewed as a row vector in broadcasting.)

把各隐藏单元的权重向量 (转置后) 作为行, 堆成 m × d 的权重矩阵 W[1]. 由矩阵乘向量的定义, W[1]x 的第 j 个分量恰好是第 j 行与 x 的内积 wj[1]⊤​x, 再加上偏置向量, 就一次算出所有 zj​ (7.14). 下标里的维数标注可用来检查: (m × d)(d × 1) = m × 1. 讲义中向量都是列向量; numpy 的一维数组在广播时按行向量处理, 写代码时要注意.

数值例子 (自编, 用 Python 核对): d = 2, m = 3, W[1] 的三行为 (0.5, −0.2)、(0.3, 0.4)、(−0.6, 0.1), b[1]=(0.1,0,0.2)⊤, x = (1, 2). 则 W[1]x=(0.1,1.1,−0.4)⊤, 加偏置得 z = (0.2, 1.1, −0.2), ReLU 后 a = (0.2, 1.1, 0). 第三个隐藏单元的预激活为负, 被 ReLU 置零. 后面反向传播的数值核对用的就是这个网络.

Page 90

Computing the activations a∈Rm from z∈Rm involves an element-wise non-linear application of the ReLU function, which can be computed in parallel efficiently. Overloading ReLU for element-wise application of ReLU (meaning, for a vector t∈Rd, ReLU(t) is a vector such that ReLU(t)i​=ReLU(ti​)), we have

a=ReLU(z)(7.15)

Define W[2]=[w[2]⊤]∈R1×m similarly. Then, the model in equation (7.11) can be summarized as

ahθ​(x)​=ReLU(W[1]x+b[1])=W[2]a+b[2](7.16)​

Here θ consists of W[1],W[2] (often referred to as the weight matrices) and b[1],b[2] (referred to as the biases). The collection of W[1],b[1] is referred to as the first layer, and W[2],b[2] the second layer. The activation a is referred to as the hidden layer. A two-layer neural network is also called one-hidden-layer neural network.

ReLU 作用在向量上表示逐元素取 ReLU. 第二层的权重写成 1 × m 的矩阵 W[2], 两层网络就是 (7.16) 两行. 术语: W[1],b[1] 是第一层, W[2],b[2] 是第二层; 激活 a 叫隐藏层. 两层网络也叫单隐藏层网络 (按权重矩阵数计层数, 输入不算一层).

Page 90

Multi-layer fully-connected neural networks. With this succinct notations, we can stack more layers to get a deeper fully-connected neural network. Let r be the number of layers (weight matrices). Let W[1],…,W[r],b[1],…,b[r] be the weight matrices and biases of all the layers. Then a multi-layer neural network can be written as

a[1]a[2]a[r−1]hθ​(x)​=ReLU(W[1]x+b[1])=ReLU(W[2]a[1]+b[2])⋯=ReLU(W[r−1]a[r−2]+b[r−1])=W[r]a[r−1]+b[r](7.17)​

We note that the weight matrices and biases need to have compatible dimensions for the equations above to make sense. If a[k] has dimension mk​, then the weight matrix W[k] should be of dimension mk​×mk−1​, and the bias b[k]∈Rmk​. Moreover, W[1]∈Rm1​×d and W[r]∈R1×mr−1​.

The total number of neurons in the network is m1​+⋯+mr​, and the total number of parameters in this network is (d+1)m1​+(m1​+1)m2​+⋯+(mr−1​+1)mr​.

多层全连接网络: r 层 (r 个权重矩阵), 前 r − 1 层都是「线性变换 + ReLU», 最后一层只有线性变换. 维数要匹配: 第 k 层的权重矩阵是 mk​×mk−1​ (输出维数 × 输入维数), 偏置是 mk​ 维; m0​=d, mr​=1. 参数总数: 第 k 层有 mk​mk−1​ 个权重和 mk​ 个偏置, 合计 (mk−1​+1)mk​.

深与宽: 同样的参数预算, 可以做成浅而宽, 也可以做成深而窄. 理论上有些函数用深网络只需多项式个神经元, 用浅网络却需要指数个 (例如反复「折叠」输入空间的锯齿函数: 每加一层 ReLU, 折点数可以翻倍). 实践中深网络在图像、语言等有层次结构的数据上明显更好, 这也是「深度」学习的名字由来.

算一下参数个数 (自编): d = 10, 两个隐藏层 m1​=32、m2​=16, 输出 1 维. 参数数 = 11 × 32 + 33 × 16 + 17 × 1 = 352 + 528 + 17 = 897 (用 Python 核对). 可以看出参数主要集中在宽层之间的权重矩阵上: 宽度翻倍, 相邻两个宽层之间的参数大约变成 4 倍.

Page 91

Sometimes for notational consistency we also write a[0]=x, and a[r]=hθ​(x). Then we have simple recursion that

​a[k]=ReLU(W[k]a[k−1]+b[k]),∀k=1,…,r−1(7.18)​

Note that this would have be true for k = r if there were an additional ReLU in equation (7.17), but often people like to make the last layer linear (aka without a ReLU) so that negative outputs are possible and it's easier to interpret the last layer as a linear model. (More on the interpretability at the “connection to kernel method” paragraph of this section.)

Other activation functions. The activation function ReLU can be replaced by many other non-linear function σ(·) that maps ℝ to ℝ such as

σ(z)=1+e−z1​(sigmoid)(7.19)

σ(z)=ez+e−zez−e−z​(tanh)(7.20)

记 a[0]=x, a[r]=hθ​(x), 前 r − 1 层可以写成统一的递推 (7.18). 最后一层通常不加 ReLU, 好让输出可以为负, 并且可以把最后一层看成一个线性模型 (见下文与核方法的联系). 其他激活函数: sigmoid (输出在 (0, 1)) 和 tanh (输出在 (−1, 1), 关于原点对称, 其实是平移缩放过的 sigmoid: tanh(z)=2σ(2z)−1).

讲义笔误: "this would have be true" 应为 "would have been true" (或 "would be true").

为什么现在多用 ReLU: sigmoid 和 tanh 在 |z| 很大时导数趋于 0 (饱和), 反向传播时这些很小的导数逐层相乘, 前面层的梯度会变得极小 (梯度消失), 深层网络很难训练. ReLU 在 z > 0 时导数恒为 1, 不饱和, 计算也最便宜. 它的缺点是 z < 0 时导数为 0, 若某个神经元对所有样本都输出 0 就再也学不动 (「死亡 ReLU»), 由此有了 Leaky ReLU、GELU 等变体 (GELU 用于 Transformer).

Page 91

Why do we not use the identity function for σ(z)? That is, why not use σ(z) = z? Assume for sake of argument that b[1] and b[2] are zeros. Suppose σ(z) = z, then for two-layer neural network, we have that

hθ​(x)​=W[2]a[1]=W[2]σ(z[1])=W[2]z[1]=W[2]W[1]x=W~x​​(7.21)(7.22)(7.23)(7.24)(7.25)​

(7.22) by definition; (7.23) since σ(z) = z; (7.24) from Equation (7.13); (7.25) where W~=W[2]W[1].

Notice how W[2]W[1] collapsed into W~.

This is because applying a linear function to another linear function will result in a linear function over the original input (i.e., you can construct a W~ such that W~x=W[2]W[1]x). This loses much of the representational power of the neural network as often times the output we are trying to predict has a non-linear relationship with the inputs. Without non-linear activation functions, the neural network will simply perform linear regression.

为什么不能用恒等函数做激活: 若 σ(z) = z, 两层网络就是 W[2]W[1]x, 两个矩阵的乘积仍是一个矩阵 W~, 网络塌缩成线性模型. 线性函数套线性函数还是线性函数, 无论叠多少层都一样; 非线性激活才是神经网络表达能力的来源. 有偏置时结论不变 (仿射套仿射仍是仿射).

易错: 只有隐藏层的非线性才增加表达能力; 输出层的激活决定的是输出的范围和损失的形式, 而不是模型能表示的函数族. 例如二分类时输出层用 sigmoid、多分类用 softmax (配合交叉熵损失, 与第 2、3 章的逻辑回归和 softmax 回归完全对应), 回归时输出层不加激活. 去掉所有隐藏层的非线性后, 「sigmoid 输出 + 多层线性」仍然只是逻辑回归.

反过来, 加了 ReLU 能表示什么: 一维时, m 个隐藏单元的两层 ReLU 网络 ∑j​cj​ReLU(wj​x+bj​)+b 是一条最多有 m 个折点的分段线性函数, 每个隐藏单元贡献一个折点. 折点足够多时可以任意精度逼近任何连续函数 (万能逼近定理). 例如 ReLU(x)−ReLU(x−1) 在 x ≤ 0 为 0, 在 0 到 1 之间线性上升, x ≥ 1 时恒为 1, 两个神经元就拼出了一个「台阶».

Page 91–92

Connection to the Kernel Method. In the previous lectures, we covered the concept of feature maps. Recall that the main motivation for feature maps is to represent functions that are non-linear in the input x by θ⊤ϕ(x), where θ are the parameters and φ(x), the feature map, is a handcrafted function non-linear in the raw input x. The performance of the learning algorithms can significantly depends on the choice of the feature map φ(x). Oftentimes people use domain knowledge to design the feature map φ(x) that suits the particular applications. The process of choosing the feature maps is often referred to as feature engineering.

We can view deep learning as a way to automatically learn the right feature map (sometimes also referred to as “the representation”) as follows. Suppose we denote by β the collection of the parameters in a fully-connected neural networks (equation (7.17)) except those in the last layer. Then we can abstract right a[r−1] as a function of the input x and the parameters in β: a[r−1]=ϕβ​(x). Now we can write the model as

hθ​(x)=W[r]ϕβ​(x)+b[r](7.26)

与核方法的联系: 核方法用人工设计的特征映射 φ(x) 表示非线性函数, 效果很依赖 φ 的选择, 设计 φ 的过程叫特征工程, 需要领域知识. 深度学习可以看作自动学习特征映射 (也叫表示): 把除最后一层以外的参数记作 β, 倒数第二层的激活 a[r−1] 就是 x 的一个函数 ϕβ​(x), 整个网络 = 「学到的特征」上的线性模型 (7.26).

两者对比: ① 特征: 核方法的 φ 固定 (由核决定), 神经网络的 ϕβ​ 可学习; ② 优化: 核方法 (如核 SVM、核岭回归) 是凸问题, 有唯一全局最优; 神经网络非凸; ③ 规模: 核方法的代价随样本数 n 增长 (n × n 核矩阵), 神经网络的代价随参数数和 n 线性增长, 更适合大数据; ④ 理论上, 宽度趋于无穷且以特定方式初始化的网络在训练中近似一个核方法 (神经正切核 NTK), 这说明两者有深层联系, 但实际网络的特征在训练中会显著变化, 不只是一个固定的核.

讲义笔误: "can significantly depends" 应为 depend; "we can abstract right a[r−1]" 中 right 多余 (大概原为 "rewrite"); "a fully-connected neural networks" 单复数不一致.

Page 92

When β is fixed, then ϕβ​(⋅) can viewed as a feature map, and therefore hθ​(x) is just a linear model over the features ϕβ​(x). However, we will train the neural networks, both the parameters in β and the parameters W[r],b[r] are optimized, and therefore we are not learning a linear model in the feature space, but also learning a good feature map ϕβ​(⋅) itself so that it's possible to predict accurately with a linear model on top of the feature map. Therefore, deep learning tends to depend less on the domain knowledge of the particular applications and requires often less feature engineering. The penultimate layer a[r] is often (informally) referred to as the learned features or representations in the context of deep learning.

β 固定时, ϕβ​ 就是一个普通的特征映射, 模型是它上面的线性模型. 但训练时 β 和最后一层一起优化, 所以不只是在特征空间里学线性模型, 还同时学习「让线性模型能预测准」的特征映射本身. 因此深度学习较少依赖领域知识和特征工程. 倒数第二层的激活被称为学到的特征 (表示).

Page 92

In the example of house price prediction, a fully-connected neural network does not need us to specify the intermediate quantity such “family size”, and may automatically discover some useful features in the last penultimate layer (the activation a[r−1]), and use them to linearly predict the housing price. Often the feature map / representation obtained from one datasets (that is, the function ϕβ​(⋅) can be also useful for other datasets, which indicates they contain essential information about the data. However, oftentimes, the neural network will discover complex features which are very useful for predicting the output but may be difficult for a human to understand or interpret. This is why some people refer to neural networks as a black box, as it can be difficult to understand the features it has discovered.

房价例子里, 网络不需要我们指定「家庭规模」这样的中间量, 可能自己发现有用的特征. 从一个数据集学到的表示常常对别的数据集也有用 (这就是第 14 章预训练、迁移学习的基础); 缺点是学到的特征常常难以解释, 所以神经网络有「黑箱」之称.

讲义问题: ① "The penultimate layer a[r]" 下标错了, 倒数第二层是 a[r−1] (下一段写对了); "the last penultimate layer" 中 last 多余. ② "However, we will train the neural networks, both … are optimized" 句子不通, 应为 "However, when we train the neural networks, …"; "can viewed as" 漏了 be; "such 'family size'" 漏了 as; "one datasets" 单复数不一致.

反向传播
7.3 Backpropagation

Page 93

In this section, we introduce backpropgation or auto-differentiation, which computes the gradient of the loss ∇J(j)(θ) efficiently. We will start with an informal theorem that states that as long as a real-valued function f can be efficiently computed/evaluated by a differentiable network or circuit, then its gradient can be efficiently computed in a similar time. We will then show how to do this concretely for fully-connected neural networks.

Because the formality of the general theorem is not the main focus here, we will introduce the terms with informal definitions. By a differentiable circuit or a differentiable network, we mean a composition of a sequence of differentiable arithmetic operations (additions, subtraction, multiplication, divisions, etc) and elementary differentiable functions (ReLU, exp, log, sin, cos, etc.). Let the size of the circuit be the total number of such operations and elementary functions. We assume that each of the operations and functions, and their derivatives or partial derivatives ecan be computed in O(1) time in the computer.

Theorem 7.3.1: [backpropagation or auto-differentiation, informally stated] Suppose a differentiable circuit of size N computes a real-valued function f:Rℓ→R. Then, the gradient ∇f can be computed in time O(N), by a circuit of size O(N).

反向传播 (也叫自动微分) 高效地计算损失的梯度. 非正式定理: 可微电路指由可微的四则运算和基本函数 (ReLU、exp、log、sin 等) 组成的计算序列, 规模 N 是运算个数; 若一个这样的电路在 N 步内算出实值函数 f, 则 f 对全部 ℓ 个输入的梯度也能在 O(N) 时间内算出. 也就是说, 求梯度的代价与求函数值本身同阶 (常数倍), 与参数个数 ℓ 无关. 这一点非常反直觉: 用有限差分逐个参数求导要 O(ℓN).

与有限差分对比: 用 (f(θ+ϵei​)−f(θ))/ϵ 逐个参数估计偏导, 一个有一百万个参数的网络每求一次梯度就要前向计算一百万次; 反向传播只需一次前向加一次反向, 大约是前向代价的 2 到 3 倍. 有限差分仍然有用: 写完反向传播后, 用它在少数几个参数上做「梯度检查», 确认实现正确 (本笔记的数值核对就是这样做的).

为什么是「反向」: 自动微分有前向模式和反向模式. 前向模式从输入出发, 一次传播只能求出所有中间量对一个输入的导数, 求 ℓ 个参数的梯度要 ℓ 次. 反向模式从输出出发, 一次传播就求出一个输出对所有输入的导数. 损失是标量、参数有几百万, 所以反向模式只需一次, 这正是定理 7.3.1 的含义. 代价是内存: 反向时要用到前向的所有中间结果, 必须全部保存.

讲义笔误: "backpropgation" 应为 backpropagation; "partial derivatives ecan be computed" 中 ecan 应为 can.

Page 93

We note that the loss function J(j)(θ) for j-th example can be indeed computed by a sequence of operations and functions involving additions, subtraction, multiplications, and non-linear activations. Thus the theorem suggests that we should be able to compute the ∇J(j)(θ) in a similar time to that for computing J(j)(θ) itself. This does not only apply to the fully-connected neural network introduced in the Section 7.2, but also many other types of neural networks.

In the rest of the section, we will showcase how to compute the gradient of the loss efficiently for fully-connected neural networks using backpropagation. Even though auto-differentiation or backpropagation is implemented in all the deep learning packages such as tensorflow and pytorch, understanding it is very helpful for gaining insights into the working of deep learning.

(Footnote 4) We note if the output of the function f does not depend on some of the input coordinates, then we set by default the gradient w.r.t that coordinate to zero. Setting to zero does not count towards the total runtime here in our accounting scheme. This is why when N ≤ ℓ, we can compute the gradient in O(N) time, which might be potentially even less than ℓ.

神经网络的单样本损失正是由加减乘和激活函数组成的, 所以算梯度的时间与算损失的时间同阶, 不只是全连接网络, 其他网络也一样. TensorFlow、PyTorch 都已经实现了自动微分, 但理解它有助于理解深度学习的工作方式. 脚注: f 不依赖的输入坐标梯度默认为 0, 不计入运行时间, 所以 N ≤ ℓ 时也是 O(N).

Page 94

7.3.1 Preliminary: chain rule

We first recall the chain rule in calculus. Suppose the variable J depends on the variables θ1​,…,θp​ via the intermediate variable g1​,…,gk​:

​gj​=gj​(θ1​,…,θp​),∀j∈{1,⋯,k}(7.27)J=J(g1​,…,gk​)(7.28)​

Here we overload the meaning of gj​'s: they denote both the intermediate variables but also the functions used to compute the intermediate variables. Then, by the chain rule, we have that ∀i,

∂θi​∂J​=j=1∑k​∂gj​∂J​∂θi​∂gj​​(7.29)

For the ease of invoking the chain rule in the following subsections in various ways, we will call J the output variable, g1​,…,gk​ intermediate variables, and θ1​,…,θp​ the input variable in the chain rule.

链式法则 (多元形式): J 通过中间变量 g1​,…,gk​ 依赖于 θ, 则 J 对 θi​ 的偏导等于「J 对每个中间变量的偏导 × 该中间变量对 θi​ 的偏导」再对所有路径求和. 求和是多元链式法则的关键: θi​ 影响 J 的每一条途径都要算上. 后面反复调用它时, 把 J 叫输出变量, g 叫中间变量, θ 叫输入变量.

多条路径的例子: J = g1​+g2​, g1​=θ2, g2​=3θ. θ 通过两条路径影响 J, 由 (7.29) 得 ∂J/∂θ=1⋅2θ+1⋅3=2θ+3, 与直接对 θ2+3θ 求导相同. 在神经网络里, 一个隐藏单元连到下一层的所有单元, 所以它的梯度要对所有下游单元求和, 矩阵写法中这个求和就是乘 W⊤.

Page 94

7.3.2 One-neuron neural networks

Simplifying notations: In the rest of the section, we will consider a generic input x and compute the gradient of hθ​(x) w.r.t θ. For simplicity, we use o as a shorthand for hθ​(x) (o stands for output). For simplicity, with slight abuse of notation, we use J=21​(y−o)2 to denote the loss function. (Note that this overrides the definition of J as the total loss in Section 7.1.) Our goal is to compute the derivative of J w.r.t the parameter θ.

We first consider the neural network with one neuron defined in equation (7.7). Recall that we compute the loss function via the following sequential steps:

zoJ​=w⊤x+b(7.30)=ReLU(z)(7.31)=21​(y−o)2(7.32)​

By the chain rule with J as the output variable, o as the intermediate variable, and wi​ the input variable, we have that

∂wi​∂J​=∂o∂J​⋅∂wi​∂o​(7.33)

记号简化: 只看一个样本, 输出 hθ​(x) 记作 o, 损失记作 J=21​(y−o)2 (覆盖了 7.1 节 J 的含义). 单个神经元的计算分三步: 线性组合 z, 激活 o, 损失 J. 先以 o 为中间变量用一次链式法则 (7.33).

Page 95

Invoking the chain rule with o as the output variable, z as the intermediate variable, and wi​ the input variable, we have that ∂wi​∂o​=∂z∂o​⋅∂wi​∂z​. Combining the equation above with equation (7.33), we have

∂wi​∂J​​=∂o∂J​⋅∂z∂o​⋅∂wi​∂z​=(o−y)⋅ReLU′(z)⋅xi​​

(because ∂o∂J​=(o−y) and ∂z∂o​=ReLU′(z) and ∂wi​∂z​=xi​)

Here, the key is that we reduce the computation of ∂wi​∂J​ to the computation of three simpler more “local” objects ∂o∂J​, ∂z∂o​, and ∂wi​∂z​, which are much simpler to compute because J directly depends on o via equation (7.32), o directly depends on a via equation (7.31), and z directly depends on wi​ via equation (7.30). Note that in a vectorized form, we can also write

∇w​J=(o−y)⋅ReLU′(z)⋅x

Similarly, we compute the gradient w.r.t b by

∂b∂J​​=∂o∂J​⋅∂z∂o​⋅∂b∂z​=(o−y)⋅ReLU′(z)​

(because ∂o∂J​=(o−y) and ∂z∂o​=ReLU′(z) and ∂b∂z​=1)

再以 z 为中间变量用一次链式法则, 三个因子相乘. 关键思想: 把复杂的偏导拆成三个局部的偏导, 每个只涉及相邻两步之间的直接依赖: ∂J/∂o=o−y (平方损失的导数), ∂o/∂z=ReLU′(z) (z > 0 时为 1, 否则为 0), ∂z/∂wi​=xi​. 写成向量就是 ∇w​J=(o−y)ReLU′(z)x. 对 b 同理, 最后一个因子是 1. 易错: z ≤ 0 时 ReLU 导数为 0, 这个样本对 w 和 b 的梯度全为 0.

讲义笔误: "o directly depends on a via equation (7.31)" 中 a 应为 z (单神经元网络里没有 a).

Page 95–96

7.3.3 Two-layer neural networks: a low-level unpacked computation

Note: this subsection derives the derivatives with low-level notations to help you build up intuition on backpropagation. If you are looking for a clean formula, or you are familiar with matrix derivatives, then feel free to jump to the next subsection directly.

Now we consider the two-layer neural network defined in equation (7.11). We compute the loss J by following sequence of operations

​∀j∈[1,…,m]:zj​=wj[1]⊤​x+bj[1]​,where wj[1]​∈Rd,bj[1]​∈Raj​=ReLU(zj​),a=[a1​,…,am​]⊤∈Rmo=w[2]⊤a+b[2],where w[2]∈Rm,b[2]∈RJ=21​(y−o)2(7.34)​

We will use (w[2])ℓ​ to denote the ℓ-th coordinate of w[2], and (wj[1]​)ℓ​ to denote the ℓ-coordinate of wj[1]​. (We will avoid using these cumbersome notations once we figure out how to write everything in matrix and vector forms.)

By invoking chain rule with J as the output variable, o as intermediate variable, and (w[2])ℓ​ as the input variable, we have

∂(w[2])ℓ​∂J​=∂o∂J​∂(w[2])ℓ​∂o​=(o−y)aℓ​

两层网络的逐分量推导 (只为建立直觉, 熟悉矩阵求导的可以跳到下一节). 前向计算 (7.34) 依次是: 各隐藏单元的 zj​、aj​, 输出 o, 损失 J. 第二层权重最简单: o 对 (w[2])ℓ​ 的偏导是 aℓ​, 所以梯度是 (o−y)aℓ​: 误差 × 这条连接的输入.

Page 96

It's more challenging to compute ∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂J​. Towards computing it, we first invoke the chain rule with J as the output variable, zj​ as the intermediate variable, and (wj[1]​)ℓ​ as the input variable.

∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂J​​=∂zj​∂J​⋅∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂zj​​=∂zj​∂J​⋅xℓ​​

(becaues ∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂zj​​=xℓ​.)

Thus, it suffices to compute the ∂zj​∂J​. We invoke the chain rule with J as the output variable, aj​ as the intermediate variable, and zj​ as the input variable,

∂zj​∂J​​=∂aj​∂J​∂zj​∂aj​​=∂aj​∂J​ReLU′(zj​)​

Now it suffices to compute ∂aj​∂J​, and we invoke the chain rule with J as the output variable, o as the intermediate variable, and aj​ as the input variable,

∂aj​∂J​​=∂o∂J​∂aj​∂o​=(o−y)⋅(w[2])j​​

Now combining the equations above, we obtain

∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂J​​=(o−y)⋅(w[2])j​⋅ReLU′(zj​)xℓ​​

第一层权重要多走几步: (wj[1]​)ℓ​ 只通过 zj​ 影响 J, 所以先拆成 ∂J/∂zj​⋅xℓ​; zj​ 只通过 aj​ 影响 J, 得 ∂J/∂aj​⋅ReLU′(zj​); aj​ 通过 o 影响 J, 得 (o−y)(w[2])j​. 合起来是四个因子的乘积: 输出误差 × 回传的权重 × 激活的导数 × 输入. 可以理解为误差 (o − y) 沿着连接 (w[2])j​ 「反向」传到隐藏单元 j, 经过激活函数的「闸门」ReLU′(zj​), 再分配给这个单元的各条输入边.

两条读法: 自上而下看, 误差信号 (o − y) 先乘第二层权重, 再过 ReLU 的闸门, 得到隐藏单元 j 的误差 ∂J/∂zj​; 自下而上看, 每个参数的梯度 = 它所在连接输出端的误差 × 输入端的值. 后一种读法对任何层都成立, 是记忆反向传播公式最简单的方法.

讲义笔误: "(becaues …)" 应为 because; "the ℓ-coordinate of" 应为 ℓ-th coordinate.

Page 97

Next we gauge the runtime of computing these partial derivatives. Let p denotes the total number of parameters in the network. We note that p ≥ md where m is the number of hidden units and d is the input dimension. For every j and ℓ, to compute ∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂J​, apparently we need to compute at least the output o, which takes at least p ≥ md operations. Therefore at the first glance computing a single gradient takes at least md time, and the total time to compute the derivatives w.r.t to all the parameters is at least (md)2, which is inefficient.

However, the key of the backpropagation is that for different choices of ℓ, the formulas above for computing ∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂J​ share many terms, such as, (o − y), (w[2])j​ and ReLU′(zj​). This suggests that we can re-organize the computation to leverage the shared computation.

It turns out the crucial shared quantities in these formulas are ∂o∂J​,∂z1​∂J​,…,∂zm​∂J​. We now write the following formulas to compute the gradients efficiently in Algorithm 3.

算一笔时间账: 参数总数 p ≥ md. 若每个偏导都从头计算, 每个至少要先算出 o (≥ md 步), 共 md 个第一层参数, 总时间至少 (md)2. 反向传播的关键: 对不同的 ℓ, 公式共享很多项: (o − y)、(w[2])j​、ReLU′(zj​), 只需计算一次. 真正需要共享的中间量是 ∂J/∂o 和各个 ∂J/∂zj​, 有了它们, 每个参数的偏导只需再乘一次.

讲义笔误: "Let p denotes" 应为 denote; "w.r.t to all the parameters" 中 to 多余.

Page 97

Algorithm 3 Backpropagation for two-layer neural networks

  1. Compute the values of z1​,…,zm​,a1​,…,am​ and o as in the definition of neural network (equation (7.34)).
  2. Compute ∂o∂J​=(o−y).
  3. Compute ∂zj​∂J​ for j = 1, …, m by ​∂zj​∂J​=∂o∂J​∂aj​∂o​∂zj​∂aj​​=∂o∂J​⋅(w[2])j​⋅ReLU′(zj​)(7.35)​
  4. Compute ∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂J​, ∂bj[1]​∂J​, ∂(w[2])j​∂J​, and ∂b[2]∂J​ by ​∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂J​=∂zj​∂J​⋅∂(wj[1]​)ℓ​∂zj​​=∂zj​∂J​⋅xℓ​∂bj[1]​∂J​=∂zj​∂J​⋅∂bj[1]​∂zj​​=∂zj​∂J​∂(w[2])j​∂J​=∂o∂J​∂(w[2])j​∂o​=∂o∂J​⋅aj​∂b[2]∂J​=∂o∂J​∂b[2]∂o​=∂o∂J​​

算法 3: ① 前向: 算出并保存所有 z、a、o; ② 算 ∂J/∂o; ③ 由它算出每个 ∂J/∂zj​ (7.35); ④ 每个参数的偏导 = 相应的 ∂J/∂z (或 ∂J/∂o) × 该参数所在连接的输入 (偏置的输入视为 1). 总时间: 前向 O(md), 第 ③ 步 O(m), 第 ④ 步 O(md), 合计 O(md), 与算一次损失同阶, 符合定理 7.3.1.

数值核对 (自编, 用 Python 计算): d = 2, m = 3, x = (1, 2), y = 3; W[1] 的三行为 (0.5, −0.2)、(0.3, 0.4)、(−0.6, 0.1), b[1]=(0.1,0,0.2), w[2]=(1,−0.5,0.8), b[2]=0.3. 前向: z = (0.2, 1.1, −0.2), a = (0.2, 1.1, 0), o = −0.05, J = 4.65125. 反向: ∂J/∂o=−3.05; ∂J/∂z=(−3.05,1.525,0) (第三个单元 z < 0, 梯度被 ReLU 截断为 0); ∂J/∂w[2]=(−0.61,−3.355,0); 第二个隐藏单元第一个输入的权重梯度 = 1.525 × 1 = 1.525. 用有限差分 (该权重加 10−6) 得 1.5250001, 与反向传播一致.

Page 98

7.3.4 Two-layer neural network with vector notation

As we have done before in the definition of neural networks, the equations for backpropagation becomes much cleaner with proper matrix notation. Here we state the algorithm first and also provide a cleaner proof via matrix calculus.

Let

δ[2]δ[1]​≜∂o∂J​∈R,≜∂z∂J​∈Rm(7.36)​

Here we note that when A is a real-valued variable, and B is a vector or matrix variable, then ∂B∂A​ denotes the collection of the partial derivatives with the same shape as B. In other words, if B is a matrix of dimension m × d, then ∂B∂A​ is a matrix in Rm×d with ∂Bij​∂A​ as the ij-th entry. Let v ⊙ w denote the entry-wise product of two vectors v and w of the same dimension. Now we are ready to describe backpropagation in Algorithm 4.

(Footnote 5) We will avoid using the notation ∂B∂A​ for A that is not a real-valued variable. (Footnote 6) If you are familiar with the notion of total derivatives, we note that the dimensionality here is different from that for total derivatives.

向量记号: 定义 δ[2]=∂J/∂o (标量) 和 δ[1]=∂J/∂z (m 维), δ 常被称为各层的「误差信号». 约定: 标量 A 对向量或矩阵 B 的偏导, 排成与 B 同形状的数组 (这样梯度下降可以直接写 B := B − α ∂A/∂B). 脚注提醒: 这与「全导数 / 雅可比矩阵」的排法不同 (雅可比矩阵对向量是行向量). ⊙ 表示逐元素乘积.

用前面的数值例子核对矩阵公式: δ[2]=o−y=−3.05; W[2]⊤=(1,−0.5,0.8)⊤, 乘以 −3.05 得 (−3.05, 1.525, −2.44), 再逐元素乘 ReLU′(z) = (1, 1, 0), 得 δ[1]=(−3.05,1.525,0), 与逐分量算法 3 的结果相同. ∂J/∂W[1]=δ[1]x⊤ 的第二行是 1.525 × (1, 2) = (1.525, 3.05), 第三行全为 0.

Page 98

Algorithm 4 Back-propagation for two-layer neural networks in vectorized notations.

  1. Compute the values of z∈Rm, a∈Rm, and o
  2. Compute δ[2]=(o−y)∈R
  3. Compute δ[1]=(o−y)⋅W[2]⊤⊙ReLU′(z)∈Rm×1
  4. Compute ∂W[2]∂J​∂b[2]∂J​∂W[1]∂J​∂b[1]∂J​​=δ[2]a⊤∈R1×m=δ[2]∈R=δ[1]x⊤∈Rm×d=δ[1]∈Rm​

算法 4 就是算法 3 的矩阵版本: δ[1] = 输出误差 × 第二层权重的转置, 再逐元素乘 ReLU 的导数; 每层的权重梯度 = 该层的 δ (列向量) × 该层输入的转置 (行向量), 是一个外积, 形状正好与权重矩阵相同; 偏置的梯度就是 δ 本身. 记忆方法: 权重矩阵 W[k] 的第 (i, j) 个元素连接输入 j 和输出 i, 它的梯度 = 输出端的误差 δi​ × 输入端的值.

Page 99

Derivation using the chain rule for matrix multiplication. To have a succinct derivation of the backpropagation algorithm in Algorithm 4 without working with the complex indices, we state the extensions of the chain rule in vectorized notations. It requires more knowledge of matrix calculus to state the most general result, and therefore we will introduce a few special cases that are most relevant for deep learning. Suppose J is a real-valued output variable, z∈Rm is the intermediate variable and W∈Rm×d, u∈Rd are the input variables. Suppose they satisfy:

zJ​=Wu+b,where W∈Rm×d=J(z)(7.37)​

Then we can compute ∂u∂J​ and ∂W∂J​ by:

∂u∂J​∂W∂J​∂b∂J​​=W⊤∂z∂J​(7.38)=∂z∂J​⋅u⊤(7.39)=∂z∂J​(7.40)​

We can verify the dimensionality is indeed compatible because ∂z∂J​∈Rm, W⊤∈Rd×m, ∂u∂J​∈Rd, ∂W∂J​∈Rm×d, u⊤∈R1×d.

矩阵形式的链式法则 (两个特例). 特例一, 线性层 z = Wu + b: 对输入 u 的梯度是 W⊤∂z∂J​ (误差经转置矩阵反向传回), 对 W 的梯度是外积 ∂z∂J​u⊤, 对 b 的梯度就是 ∂z∂J​. 推导: zi​=∑j​Wij​uj​+bi​, 所以 ∂J/∂uj​=∑i​(∂J/∂zi​)Wij​, 正是 W⊤ 的第 j 行乘 ∂J/∂z; ∂J/∂Wij​=(∂J/∂zi​)uj​, 正是外积的 (i, j) 元. 用维数检查可以帮助记住转置放在哪.

Page 99

Here the chain rule in equation (7.38) only works for the special cases where z = Wu. Another useful case is the following:

​a=σ(z), where σ is anelement-wise activation,z,a∈RdJ=J(a)​

Then, we have that

∂z∂J​=∂a∂J​⊙σ′(z)(7.41)

where σ′(·) is the element-wise derivative of the activation function σ, and ⊙ is element-wise product of two vectors of the same dimensionality.

Using equation (7.38), (7.39), and (7.41), we can verify the correctness of Algorithm 4. Indeed, using the notations in the two-layer neural network

∂z∂J​​=∂a∂J​⊙ReLU′(z)=(o−y)W[2]⊤⊙ReLU′(z)​

(The first step by invoking equation (7.41) with setting J ← J, a ← a, z ← a, σ ← ReLU; the second step by invoking equation (7.38) with setting J ← J, z ← o, W←W[2], u ← a, b←b[2].)

特例二, 逐元素激活 a = σ(z): 每个 ai​ 只依赖 zi​, 所以 ∂J/∂zi​=(∂J/∂ai​)σ′(zi​), 写成向量就是逐元素乘积 (7.41). 验证算法 4 第 3 行: 先用特例二把 ∂J/∂z 化成 ∂J/∂a⊙ReLU′(z), 再用特例一 (把输出层 o=W[2]a+b[2] 看作线性层) 得 ∂J/∂a=W[2]⊤(o−y). 两个特例交替使用, 就是任意深度网络的反向传播.

Therefore, δ[1]=∂z∂J​, and we verify the correctness of Line 3 in Algorithm 4. Similarly, let's verify the third equation in Line 4,

∂W[1]∂J​​=∂z∂J​⋅x⊤=δ[1]x⊤​

(The first step by invoking equation (7.39) with setting J ← J, z ← z, W←W[1], u ← x, b←b[1]; the second because we have proved δ[1]=∂z∂J​.)

7.3.5 Multi-layer neural networks

In this section, we will derive the backpropagation algorithms for the model defined in (7.17). Recall that we have

a[1]a[2]a[r−1]a[r]J​=ReLU(W[1]x+b[1])=ReLU(W[2]a[1]+b[2])⋯=ReLU(W[r−1]a[r−2]+b[r−1])=z[r]=W[r]a[r−1]+b[r]=21​(a[r]−y)2​

Here we define both a[r] and z[r] as hθ​(x) for notational simplicity. Define

δ[k]=∂z[k]∂J​(7.42)

The backpropagation algorithm computes δ[k]'s from k = r to 1, and computes ∂W[k]∂J​ from δ[k] as described in Algorithm 5.

Algorithm 5 Back-propagation for multi-layer neural networks.

  1. Compute and store the values of a[k]'s and z[k]'s for k = 1, …, r − 1, and J. ▷ This is often called the “forward pass”
  2. Compute δ[r]=∂z[r]∂J​=(z[r]−o).
  3. for k = r − 1 to 1 do
  4. Compute δ[k]​=∂z[k]∂J​=(W[k+1]⊤δ[k+1])⊙ReLU′(z[k])​
  5. Compute ∂W[k+1]∂J​∂b[k+1]∂J​​=δ[k+1]a[k]⊤=δ[k+1]​

多层网络: 定义每层的误差信号 δ[k]=∂J/∂z[k]. 算法 5: ① 前向传播, 保存每层的 z[k] 和 a[k] (反向时要用); ② 输出层 δ[r] = 预测 − 真值; ③ 从 k = r − 1 往回到 1: 把上一层的 δ 乘以权重矩阵的转置传回来, 再逐元素乘本层激活的导数; ④ 每层权重的梯度 = δ × 该层输入的转置, 偏置的梯度 = δ. 循环到 k = 1 时第 ⑤ 步算的是 W[2]; W[1] 的梯度 δ[1]x⊤ (即 a[0]=x) 要在循环结束后再算一次, 算法里没有明写.

梯度消失与爆炸: 展开递推, δ[1] 大约是 W[2]⊤D1​W[3]⊤D2​⋯ 这样一长串矩阵的乘积乘上 δ[r] (Dk​ 是 ReLU′ 构成的对角矩阵). 若这些矩阵的「尺度」普遍小于 1, 乘积随深度指数衰减, 前面层几乎学不动 (梯度消失); 普遍大于 1 则指数增长 (梯度爆炸). 这就是深层网络需要精心初始化 (如 Xavier、He 初始化)、归一化层和残差连接的原因.

讲义笔误: 算法 5 第 2 行 δ[r]=(z[r]−o) 写错了: o 就是 z[r], 这样恒为 0; 由 J=21​(a[r]−y)2 应为 δ[r]=z[r]−y.

按训练样本向量化
7.4 Vectorization over training examples

Page 100–101

As we discussed in Section 7.1, in the implementation of neural networks, we will leverage the parallelism across the multiple examples. This means that we will need to write the forward pass (the evaluation of the outputs) of the neural network and the backward pass (backpropagation) for multiple training examples in matrix notation.

The basic idea. The basic idea is simple. Suppose you have a training set with three examples x(1),x(2),x(3). The first-layer activations for each example are as follows:

z[1](1)z[1](2)z[1](3)​=W[1]x(1)+b[1]=W[1]x(2)+b[1]=W[1]x(3)+b[1]​

Note the difference between square brackets [·], which refer to the layer number, and parenthesis (·), which refer to the training example number. Intuitively, one would implement this using a for loop. It turns out, we can vectorize these operations as well. First, define:

X=​∣x(1)∣​∣x(2)∣​∣x(3)∣​​

X∈Rd×3(7.43)

Note that we are stacking training examples in columns and not rows. We can then combine this into a single unified formulation:

Z[1]=​∣z[1](1)∣​∣z[1](2)∣​∣z[1](3)∣​​

Z[1]=W[1]X+b[1](7.44)

除了在单个样本内部向量化, 还要在多个样本之间并行: 前向和反向都对一批样本写成矩阵运算. 例: 三个样本的第一层预激活各算一次是一个循环; 把样本按列排成 d × 3 的矩阵 X, 就能一次算出 Z[1]=W[1]X+b[1], 第 i 列就是第 i 个样本的 z[1](i). 记号: 方括号是层号, 圆括号是样本号.

反向传播也按批向量化: 把一批 B 个样本的 δ 也按列排成矩阵 Δ[k] (mk​×B), 则这一批的平均损失对权重的梯度是 B1​Δ[k]A[k−1]⊤: 矩阵乘法自动把 B 个外积加了起来. 偏置的梯度是 Δ[k] 按行求和再除以 B. 所以整个小批量 SGD 的一步就是几次大矩阵乘法, 非常适合 GPU.

Page 101–102

You may notice that we are attempting to add b[1]∈R4×1 to W[1]X∈R4×3. Strictly following the rules of linear algebra, this is not allowed. In practice however, this addition is performed using broadcasting. We create an intermediate b~[1]∈R4×3:

b~[1]=​∣b[1]∣​∣b[1]∣​∣b[1]∣​​(7.45)

We can then perform the computation: Z[1]=W[1]X+b~[1]. Often times, it is not necessary to explicitly construct b~[1]. By inspecting the dimensions in (7.44), you can assume b[1]∈R4×1 is correctly broadcast to W[1]X∈R4×3.

The matricization approach as above can easily generalize to multiple layers, with one subtlety though, as discussed below.

维数问题: 偏置 b[1] 是一列, W[1]X 有 3 列, 严格按线性代数不能相加. 实践中靠广播: 把偏置复制成 3 列再加 (7.45); 程序库会自动完成, 不必真的构造这个矩阵. 推广到多层只有一个细节问题, 见下一张卡片.

讲义问题: 这里突然出现 R4×1、R4×3, 即默认隐藏单元数 m = 4 (大概沿用 Figure 7.3 的 4 个隐藏单元), 但正文前面没有说明; 一般应写 Rm×1 和 Rm×3.

Page 102

Complications/Subtlety in the Implementation. All the deep learning packages or implementations put the data points in the rows of a data matrix. (If the data point itself is a matrix or tensor, then the data are concentrated along the zero-th dimension.) However, most of the deep learning papers use a similar notation to these notes where the data points are treated as column vectors. There is a simple conversion to deal with the mismatch: in the implementation, all the columns become row vectors, row vectors become column vectors, all the matrices are transposed, and the orders of the matrix multiplications are flipped. In the example above, using the row major convention, the data matrix is X∈R3×d, the first layer weight matrix has dimensionality d × m (instead of m × d as in the two layer neural net section), and the bias vector b[1]∈R1×m. The computation for the hidden activation becomes

Z[1]=XW[1]+b[1]∈R3×m(7.46)

(Footnote 7) The instructor suspects that this is mostly because in mathematics we naturally multiply a matrix to a vector on the left hand side.

实现上的细节: 所有深度学习库都把样本放在数据矩阵的行上 (样本是矩阵或张量时沿第 0 维拼接), 而大多数论文和本讲义把样本当列向量. 转换方法: 列向量变行向量, 所有矩阵转置, 矩阵乘法的顺序颠倒. 于是 X 是 3 × d, 第一层权重是 d × m, 偏置是 1 × m, 隐藏层 Z[1]=XW[1]+b[1] (7.46). 这其实就是对 (7.44) 两边取转置: (WX)⊤=X⊤W⊤. 例如 PyTorch 的 nn.Linear 计算的就是 xA⊤+b, 其权重 A 按 (输出维 × 输入维) 存储, 与讲义的 W 相同, 乘的时候转置. 脚注: 讲义作者认为论文习惯列向量, 是因为数学里矩阵习惯从左边乘向量.

代码里的样子 (行样本约定, numpy 写法): 前向 Z1 = X @ W1 + b1, A1 = np.maximum(Z1, 0), O = A1 @ W2 + b2; 反向 dO = (O - Y) / B, dW2 = A1.T @ dO, dA1 = dO @ W2.T, dZ1 = dA1 * (Z1 > 0), dW1 = X.T @ dZ1. 与讲义的列向量公式逐条对照, 正好是每个矩阵转置、乘法顺序颠倒. 练习单 PS4 第 1 题 (卷积网络) 的模板也用这种约定: forward_linear 中权重形状是 (输入特征数, 输出特征数), 计算 data.dot(weights) + bias.

讲义笔误: "the data are concentrated along the zero-th dimension" 中 concentrated 应为 concatenated (沿第 0 维拼接).
